headlines.title: What Could American Electric Power Company (AEP) Gain From 12 Indiana SMRs?
headlines.summary: American Electric Power Company (NasdaqGS:AEP), Amazon and X-energy are exploring the deployment of up to 12 small modular nuclear reactors at a former coal plant in Indiana. The parties plan to assess repurposing existing coal infrastructure at the site to host X-energy reactors and supporting facilities. Amazon is being evaluated as a contracted buyer of future output from the reactors to supply long-duration power for its operations and data centers.

headlines.title: Is Bigger Grid Spending Altering The Investment Case For American Electric Power (AEP)?
headlines.summary: American Electric Power created AEP Infrastructure, a new unit that will invest in, build and operate energy assets, and lifted its 2027 to 2031 capital plan to US$100.4b to support rising demand from data centers and industrial customers. The move concentrates a large pool of long-term contracted load, potential acquisitions and customer-owned infrastructure projects in one platform, which could reshape how AEP earns returns on generation, transmission and distribution spending.

headlines.title: American Electric Power Company (AEP) Stock Looks Above Fair Value On Dividends
headlines.summary: American Electric Power Company has delivered a strong share price run in recent years, and the question now is whether that move still lines up with the dividend checks investors expect to collect from here. Over the past 3 years, American Electric Power Company has returned 84.9%, which puts real weight on whether the current share price can be explained by the dividend stream alone.

headlines.summary: A proprietary transmission design carrying six times more power could reshape how utilities monetize grid upgrades for decades.

headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of American Electric Power (AEP) on Nov. 10
headlines.summary: ETFs sold $19.0 million of American Electric Power on Tuesday, with 27 funds buying and 10 selling.

description: American Electric Power Company, Inc., an electric public utility holding company, engages in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity for sale to retail and wholesale customers in the United States. It operates through Vertically Integrated Utilities, Transmission and Distribution Utilities, AEP Transmission Holdco, and Generation & Marketing segments. The company generates electricity using coal and lignite, nuclear, natural gas, renewable, hydro, solar, wind, and other energy sources; owns, operates, maintains, and invests in transmission infrastructure; and engages in the retail supply, and wholesale energy trading and marketing businesses. It operates approximately 252,000 circuit miles of distribution lines; 38,000 circuit miles of transmission lines; and 25,000 MWs of regulated owned generating capacity. American Electric Power Company, Inc. was incorporated in 1906 and is headquartered in Columbus, Ohio.
